message.ChinText:
為配合T4主幹路工程，由獅子山隧道公路（北行）前往沙田路（北行）的主路將於2026 年9 月19 日凌晨0 時01 分至上午5 時30 分臨時封閉。於道路封閉期間，駕駛人士需使用改道路線前往目的地。
駕駛者須細心留意及遵從現場的交通標誌。有關臨時交通安排，請參閲交通通告。

message.EngText:
To facilitate the construction of T4 Trunk Road, the main road of Sha Tin Road (northbound) from Lion Rock Tunnel Road (Northbound) will be temporarily closed from 00:01 am to 05:30 am on 19 September 2026. During the road closure, motorists are advised to use diversion route to reach their destination.
Motorists should pay attention and follow the traffic signs at scene. Please refer to the Traffic Advice for details of the temporary traffic arrangement.
